designationHistory.indexText: Rappahannock River Valley National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1996 to conserve and protect fish and wildlife resources, including endangered and threatened species and wetlands.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
